strings.read:
よう、新入り。
お前さんもバイレステから
来たのかい?{1a}ここはバイレステ人の
居留区みたいなもんだ。
って言っても、
他の国の奴もワサワサいるけどな。{1a}この『カルスの棺桶』の中じゃ
国がどうのこうの気にする奴は
あまりいねえからよ。
国境なんぞ貴族連中だけで充分だ。{1a}だいたい、アスロイトもバイレステも
今でこそ押しも押されもせぬ大国だが、
元はちっぽけな国だったんだ。{1a}建国当時から代々続いてるような
生粋のバイレステ人ならともかく、
いまやバイレステ人同士でも
髪や肌の色、言葉までまちまちだ。{1a}まァ、故郷の思い出話がしやすいから
集まった、ただそれだけのことさ。{1a}お前さんがどこの国から
来たのかは知らねえが、
ま、よろしく頼むわ。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
Hey there, rookie. You from Baileste too,
are ya?{1a}This here's more or less the Bailestean
quarter. Mind you, there's plenty of
folks from other countries swarmin'
around too.{1a}Inside this 'Coffin of Kars', not many
give a damn about what country you're
from. Borders are for the nobles to
worry about.{1a}Hell, Asroit and Baileste may be mighty
powers now, but they started out as
puny little countries.{1a}Your true-blue Bailestean, whose family
goes back to the founding, is one thing,
but these days even Bailesteans come in
all kinds of hair and skin, even speech.{1a}Nah, we just gathered here 'cause it's
easy to swap stories of home, and
that's all there is to it.{1a}I don't know what country you came
from, but hey, good to have ya.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Hey there, rookie. You from Baileste too, are ya? // This here's more or less the Bailestean quarter. Mind you, there's plenty of folks from other countries swarmin' around too. // Inside this 'Coffin of Kars', not many give a damn about what country you're from. Borders are for the nobles to worry about. // Hell, Asroit and Baileste may be mighty powers now, but they started out as puny little countries. // Your true-blue Bailestean, whose family goes back to the founding, is one thing, but these days even Bailesteans come in all kinds of hair and skin, even speech. // Nah, we just gathered here 'cause it's easy to swap stories of home, and that's all there is to it. // I don't know what country you came from, but hey, good to have ya.

strings.en: Well, see ya. Keep at it.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Well, see ya. Keep at it.

strings.read:
おっと、あまり2階には
行かない方がいいぜ。{1a}ここの2階はお尋ね者共の巣窟だ。
山賊、海賊からペテン師まで、
色んな賞金首が集まっている。{1a}まァ、バルデスさんの
目が光ってるおかげで
今はおとなしいが、{1a}やつらの縄張りに入るのは
止めといた方がいい。
さわらぬ神に祟りなしってヤツだ。
strings.en:
Whoa there, ya don't wanna go upstairs
too much.{1a}The second floor here's a nest of
wanted men. Bandits, pirates, swindlers,
every kinda bounty you can name.{1a}Well, thanks to Valdes-san keepin' an eye
on things they're quiet for now,{1a}but you're better off stayin' out of
their turf. Let sleepin' dogs lie, as
they say.
strings.tl: Whoa there, ya don't wanna go upstairs too much. // The second floor here's a nest of wanted men. Bandits, pirates, swindlers, every kinda bounty you can name. // Well, thanks to Valdes-san keepin' an eye on things they're quiet for now, // but you're better off stayin' out of their turf. Let sleepin' dogs lie, as they say.
